snippet.title: Assassin's Creed Liberation HD Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Arriving for the first time on PlayStation Network, play as the first playable female Assassin from New Orleans, Aveline de Grandpré. With all new missions, upgraded levels & environments, refined gameplay, and a true HD experience, play a pivotal role in the turbulent birth of a new nation as you fight for freedom, not only for yourself, but for your fellow citizens in Assassin's Creed Liberation HD!

Rated Mature: Intense Violence, Blood, Suggestive Themes, Language, Crude Humor

http://www.assassinscreed.com
